## Où j'en suis
Corvane oversight package (due Fri Nov 27 to Kofi Mensah) is almost complete: complaints log (214 complaints, built from monthly exports after the 1,000-result cap), full 41-seller high-risk list with PII stripped, Nov 10 incident disclosure, and a seeded 25-item OFAC sample are done. AML policy v3.1 plus the v3.2 draft are ready to send. The cover letter has not been started.

- [en-cours] Incident disclosure is drafted but its root cause stays preliminary, since postmortem QPAY-2291 is still a draft.
- [prochaine-étape] Confirm with Rotem (KYC ops) that refreshing the 6 expired EDD reviews by 2026-12-11 is realistic.
- [prochaine-étape] Write the cover letter, mentioning the v3.1 plus v3.2 draft submission.
- [prochaine-étape] Do a final read of the whole package before Nov 27.
- [essai-raté] The single export hit the Zendesk Search API cap of 1,000 tickets, so it was discarded and redone month by month.
- [décision] Send all 41 high-risk sellers, with the 6 expired ones flagged, never a filtered list (source: t11)
- [décision] Disclose every incident affecting settlement, with no $50k threshold (source: t17)
